meta.title: Jack in the Box NNN decision brief — central Los Angeles area
meta.premise: Reported Jack in the Box NNN-leased property near central Los Angeles with approximate 2030–2035 lease expiry. The parcel, legal tenant, guarantor, rent, value, debt, condition, insurance, tax basis, and owner finances remain unverified.
meta.recommendation: Prepare sale and renewal cases in parallel. Preserve notice and option rights, verify the actual obligor and lease, and compare after-tax net sale proceeds (accounting for LA's 0.56%/4.56%/6.06% transfer-tax tiers) with risk-adjusted ownership value while monitoring Jack in the Box's 2029–2032 debt ARD wall ($1.430B / 95.8% of principal). Do not make an irreversible sell/extend choice or drift to expiry without a funded re-tenanting alternative.
meta.privacy: No owner, parcel, lease-party, or personal financial identifiers are published. Unverified property values are blank and flagged. Local worksheet inputs default blank and stay in browser memory only.

stress.name: Rent interruption
stress.symbol: m months of zero rent plus re-tenanting downtime
stress.formula: Lost rent = monthly verified rent × m; add verified downtime costs

stress.name: NNN cost leakage
stress.symbol: c = annual owner-paid costs not recovered
stress.formula: Net operating income = verified rent − verified unrecovered owner costs

stress.name: Re-tenanting / capital shock
stress.symbol: K = tenant improvements, leasing commissions, roof/HVAC/seismic/parking capital
stress.formula: Subtract K in the year incurred; do not assume zero because lease is labeled NNN

stress.name: Exit valuation shock
stress.symbol: Δcap = change in market cap rate; ΔNOI = change in stabilized NOI
stress.formula: Exit value = stabilized NOI ÷ market cap rate; both inputs require evidence

stress.name: Discount-rate shock
stress.formula: PV = Σ after-tax cash flow_t ÷ (1+r)^t; r is not the Treasury yield by default

stress.name: Tax / transfer-cost shock
stress.symbol: ΔT = change in federal/state/local tax and transfer costs
stress.formula: Net sale proceeds = price − debt payoff − transaction costs − verified taxes

stress.name: Hazard / insurance shock
stress.symbol: Uninsured loss U, deductible D, premium increase P, business-interruption gap B
stress.formula: Owner loss = U + D + unrecovered rent interruption + P; county EAL is not a parcel loss estimate

decisions.when: Best when verified after-tax net proceeds exceed risk-adjusted hold value, remaining term is short, buyer pricing is executable, or concentration/liquidity risk is unacceptable.
decisions.tradeoffs: crystallizes value and reduces single-tenant/hazard exposure; may trigger tax, transfer costs, and loss of future upside.
decisions.required: Executed lease, obligor/guaranty, rent roll, title, debt payoff, tax basis, appraisal/BOV, insurance, and closing-cost estimate.
decisions.verdict: Prepare now; do not commit without verified net proceeds and hold comparison.

decisions.when: Best when the actual obligor is creditworthy, extension rent/terms are market-supported, guaranty and repair allocations are enforceable, and extended-term value exceeds sale proceeds.
decisions.tradeoffs: Can stabilize cash flow and saleability; may lock below-market rent, weak credit, or landlord capital obligations.
decisions.required: Option/notice dates, tenant financials, guaranty, market rent evidence, amendment terms, and capital plan.
decisions.verdict: Negotiate in parallel; preserve rights; sign only after credit and value tests.

decisions.when: Only if verified cash flow, reserves, insurance, and re-tenanting plan cover expiry, vacancy, capital, and tax risks better than sale/extension.
decisions.tradeoffs: Retains upside but accumulates lease-decay, vacancy, and hazard exposure; passive drift is not a strategy.
decisions.required: Funded reserve plan, downtime budget, re-tenanting strategy, insurance quotes, and exit alternatives.
decisions.verdict: Not recommended as default without a funded expiry plan.

decisions.when: Best when alternative-use or owner-user value exceeds investor NNN value after entitlement, environmental, and capital costs.
decisions.tradeoffs: Can unlock land value; entitlement, zoning, environmental, and execution risk are high.
decisions.required: Parcel zoning/overlays, Phase I/II, title, access/parking, entitlement feasibility, and buyer demand.
decisions.verdict: Test only after parcel match; no redevelopment value assumed.

decisions.when: Best when tax deferral and diversification improve after-tax wealth preservation and replacement assets are verified.
decisions.tradeoffs: Deferral is not forgiveness; timing, boot, replacement quality, and concentration risk remain.
decisions.required: Tax advisor confirmation, qualified intermediary, 45/180-day calendar, replacement underwriting, and California conformity review.
decisions.verdict: Evaluate as sale execution alternative, not a separate property verdict.

decisions.when: Only if verified debt terms improve liquidity without over-levering a short-term lease or weakening covenant resilience.
decisions.tradeoffs: Can extract liquidity but adds rate, maturity, and refinancing risk near expiry.
decisions.required: Loan documents, payoff/prepayment, rate quotes, DSCR/debt yield, lease term, and reserve capacity.
decisions.verdict: Secondary tool; not a substitute for lease/credit resolution.

decisions.when: Necessary fallback if tenant does not extend; best when downtime, capital, and replacement rent are funded and market-tested.
decisions.tradeoffs: Preserves ownership but requires capital, leasing time, and execution risk.
decisions.required: Market rent study, tenant improvement budget, leasing commissions, zoning, condition report, and reserve funding.
decisions.verdict: Build the fallback now; do not wait until expiry.

risks.name: Lease-term decay
risks.mechanism: Shortening remaining term can reduce buyer pool, financing options, and value even if rent is current.
risks.context: Reported expiry range 2030–2035 is unverified; exact term drives the decision.
risks.mitigation: Verify dates/options; calendar notices; price sale and extension cases in parallel.

risks.name: Tenant / guarantor credit
risks.mechanism: Brand strength does not equal lease credit; franchisee or subsidiary obligor may be weaker than issuer.
risks.context: Q3 FY26 SSS −1.1%, franchise allowance for credit losses up 70.3% to $(7,607)k, HoldCo >5.0x & Senior ABS >5.25x ($23.3M sweep), 95.8% of debt ($1.430B) facing 2029–2032 ARDs.
risks.mitigation: Identify legal tenant/guarantor; review financials, guaranty scope, defaults, and assignment rights.

risks.name: NNN label versus actual obligations
risks.mechanism: Landlord may retain roof, structure, parking, insurance, tax, or capital obligations.
risks.context: No executed lease provided.
risks.mitigation: Read lease/amendments; build unrecovered-cost and capital reserve schedule.

risks.name: Above-market rent / renewal reset
risks.mechanism: Contract rent above market can create expiry cliff and extension pressure.
risks.context: No subject rent or market rent study verified.
risks.mitigation: Obtain market rent evidence and tenant sales coverage if available; stress renewal rent.

risks.name: Vacancy and re-tenanting downtime
risks.mechanism: Expiry or default can interrupt rent while taxes, insurance, debt service, and capital continue.
risks.context: No downtime, TI/LC, or replacement rent verified.
risks.mitigation: Fund reserve; pre-market fallback; test m-month rent interruption symbolically.

risks.name: Interest-rate / cap-rate repricing
risks.mechanism: Higher required returns can reduce value and buyer leverage.
risks.context: Treasury 10Y 4.88% on November 9, 2026 is context, not a cap rate.
risks.mitigation: Stress exit cap and discount rate with evidence-backed ranges; avoid fixed-rate assumptions.

risks.name: Transfer taxes and closing costs
risks.mechanism: City ULA, base transfer tax, county tax, brokerage, and payoff can materially reduce net proceeds.
risks.mitigation: Confirm jurisdiction, exemptions, closing date, and allocation; model after-tax net proceeds.

risks.name: Property-tax reassessment
risks.mechanism: Sale or ownership change can reset assessed value and change buyer underwriting.
risks.context: Prop 13 general levy 1% plus assessments; actual bill unknown.
risks.mitigation: Review current bill, direct assessments, and reassessment treatment with tax advisor.

risks.name: Capital gain / depreciation recapture
risks.mechanism: Federal and California tax can change sale versus hold ranking.
risks.context: California individual gains taxed as ordinary income; owner basis unknown.
risks.mitigation: Obtain basis/depreciation and entity details; compare after-tax outcomes; evaluate 1031 timing.

risks.name: Insurance availability / premium shock
risks.mechanism: Coverage gaps, deductibles, exclusions, or premium increases can reduce net rent and marketability.
risks.context: CDI tracker $25.2B paid; FAIR Plan commercial limits expanded to $20M/bldg ($100M/loc) thru 2028; Verisk wildfire cat model approved Jul 2025 w/ 85% distressed-area rule.
risks.mitigation: Collect policy forms, loss runs, renewal quotes, and business-interruption terms.

risks.name: Labor and input-cost pressure
risks.mechanism: Wage floors and food/energy inflation can pressure tenant margins and renewal capacity.
risks.context: CA fast-food $20.00/hr; LA City $18.42/hr; CA general rising to $17.40/hr eff. Jan 1, 2027; LA metro energy CPI +20.3% YoY.
risks.mitigation: Review tenant sales coverage and cost structure; do not assume rent growth matches CPI.

risks.name: Access, visibility, parking, circulation
risks.mechanism: Site utility can change with traffic, construction, curb cuts, parking, and neighborhood operations.
risks.context: No parcel or traffic study verified.
risks.mitigation: Inspect access/parking; review public works and zoning after parcel match.

risks.name: Crime / perception / operating hours
risks.mechanism: Safety and perception can affect customer traffic, tenant operations, and buyer demand.
risks.context: LAPD thru Oct 31, 2026: Citywide −10.6% YoY (83,596), Operations-Central Bureau 23,423 (−2.0% overall, 28% of citywide) with Larceny +10.0% and Robbery +1.3%.
risks.mitigation: Use current official area data and on-site observation after parcel match.

risks.name: Contamination / historical use
risks.mechanism: Restaurant, automotive, or industrial history can create assessment, cleanup, financing, and liability issues.
risks.context: No Phase I/II provided.
risks.mitigation: Order Phase I; escalate to Phase II if recognized environmental conditions appear.

risks.name: Earthquake
risks.mechanism: Structural damage, business interruption, insurance gaps, and regional repricing can impair value.
risks.context: FEMA NRI 100 / $4.57B EAL; USGS 60%/46%/31% 30-yr; ShakeOut M7.8 $191B scenario; CGS 50-ft fault setback & liquefaction zone NHD rules.
risks.mitigation: Seismic/structural review, insurance adequacy, emergency plan, and capital reserve.

risks.name: Wildfire / smoke / insurance market
risks.mechanism: Direct fire, smoke, access closure, utility shutoff, and insurance repricing can affect asset even without parcel burn.
risks.context: 769,561 Very High acres (65.3% of mapped); 2026 SRA update public comment active (Nov 2026); Palisades 23,448 ac / Eaton 14,021 ac; 61 of 88 FEMA LA declarations are Fire.
risks.mitigation: Parcel FHSZ check, defensible space, roof/vent review, insurance and business-interruption review.

risks.name: Inland flooding / storm drainage
risks.mechanism: Pluvial/fluvial flooding can damage building, interrupt access, and increase insurance/capital costs.
risks.context: FEMA county inland flood risk Very High; parcel flood zone unknown.
risks.mitigation: FIRM/Elevation review, drainage inspection, flood insurance and emergency plan.

risks.name: Heat, landslide, wind, lightning, tornado
risks.mechanism: Secondary hazards can affect operations, utilities, insurance, and capital needs.
risks.context: County ratings: heat/landslide/tornado Relatively High; lightning Very High; strong wind Relatively Moderate.
risks.mitigation: Include in property condition and insurance review; do not assign parcel probabilities from county ratings.

risks.name: Tenant bankruptcy or system shock
risks.mechanism: Lease rejection, rent reduction, or brand impairment can create abrupt vacancy and value loss.
risks.context: Issuer closure guidance and negative SSS show pressure; no subject default verified.
risks.mitigation: Guaranty review, default remedies, reserve funding, and pre-negotiated fallback tenants.

risks.name: Capital-market freeze
risks.mechanism: Buyer financing or owner refinancing can disappear near expiry, forcing price or term concessions.
risks.context: Treasury yields are observable; property debt and buyer leverage unknown.
risks.mitigation: Avoid maturity cliff; maintain liquidity; test all-cash buyer and extension cases.

risks.name: Regulatory / tax / zoning shock
risks.mechanism: New transfer taxes, wage rules, zoning, or environmental requirements can change net proceeds or use value.
risks.context: ULA thresholds and wage floors already changed; future policy unknown.
risks.mitigation: Monitor official rule changes; preserve optionality; avoid irreversible entitlement assumptions.

risks.name: Compound disaster
risks.mechanism: Hazard plus insurance withdrawal plus tenant weakness plus capital-market stress can interact nonlinearly.
risks.context: County NRI composite Very High and resilience Very Low; no parcel loss model verified.
risks.mitigation: Use combined stress cases, liquidity reserves, and exit optionality; do not rely on single-risk averages.
